sloka: समुद्यम्य महाकायो ननाद युधि भैरवम् ।संरक्तनयनो रोषात् स्वसैन्यमभिहर्षयन् ।। ६.१०४.१४ ।।
transliteration: samudyamya mahākāyo nanāda yudhi bhairavam ।saṁraktanayano roṣāt svasainyamabhiharṣayan ।। 6.104.14 ।।

translations.english: Gigantic Ravana, eyes turned red in anger, raising the trident made formidable noise to make his army extremely joyful in the battlefield.
